tools.name: describe_your_need
tools.description: Optional, free, read-only. Describe what you are trying to get done and why you came to Taskin. Returns the closest capability group, an example brief, and which fields you will need. Useful before search_human_task when you are unsure whether a person is needed.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_taskin_capabilities" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_human_task · Private data: search_human_task · Public sink: submit_human_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_human_task · Private data: search_human_task · Public sink: submit_human_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
